title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
author: TJ Klune
summary: A rule-following caseworker is sent to inspect an island orphanage for magical children and its mysterious caretaker. The visit upends his careful life.
readIf: You want a warm, funny story about being accepted as you are.
skipIf: You find gentle stories predictable, or want a lot of plot twists.

pairings.reason: Another low-stakes fantasy where kindness and a good home matter more than any battle.
A love story with the same humour and optimism, set in the real world.
